items.q: I'm sorry. You're a good friendship with Oliver through the years? Oh, yeah. Sure.

I think it was Bugs Moran. Bugs Moran? Dean O'Bannon. We were playing ball and I was covering third. He slid right into me and down I went. Oh, yeah? So I got right…
Pops, Faust and Muggsy, Spaniel, April 21st, 1957, Reel 2.
